task.title: L12 Scrapling expansion: implementation of the protected-path workstreams (host operations, Super-User protected-surface diagnosis)
task.objective: Owner request 2026-10-04. Covers the L12 edits that touch protected paths: the parser-only host (native-hosts/dom-intelligence) gains a candidate-set filter and a one-entry parse cache on find_candidates (L12.2, L12.3) and a find_similar operation (L12.8, L12.12, L12.13), every new operation a closed key set, size-bounded, and inside the existing audit-hook sandbox; and the Super-User-only protected-surface diagnosis permission (L12.17) in src/security, excluded from ADMINISTRATOR_PERMISSIONS and re-auth gated, with CAPTCHA, security-check and blocked-automation pages refused for every role. Unprotected product work (runner, main IPC, renderer, verifiers) is ordinary direct-loop work outside the lease. Tracker updates for awkit-djnl.21 children use the project-state lease.

acceptance.description: find_candidates accepts an optional bounded candidateIndices list and scores only those stamped elements, reuses the last parsed page for an identical snapshot, and find_similar answers bounded indices for one stamped element. Unknown keys and out-of-bound values are still refused, the audit-hook sandbox is unchanged, and verify:dom-intelligence-host passes.

The protected-surface diagnosis permission is granted to Super User only, excluded from Administrator, re-auth gated, off by default, audited, and never admits CAPTCHA, security-check or blocked-automation pages. Role access is checked in both directions.

evidence.command: the L12.17 permission and protected-surface verifier

history.released_reason: host committed with candidate filter, parse cache and find_similar, verify:dom-intelligence-host 94/0, client and verifier work continues unleased
